svg.desc: Both panels show the same synthetic observations. Adding 273.15 changes absolute numerical temperatures but leaves a 49-degree decrease equal to a 49-kelvin decrease. Values and axis labels reflect the conversion; this is not a second experiment.
svg.title: One record in Celsius and Kelvin
